title: Reward-free versus rewarded cortical learning

titles: Cortex-wide mouse learning before and after rewarded or reward-free exposure

scientific_question: Across paired before/after animals, how do reward-free and rewarded regimes differ in calcium stimulus selectivity on common observed movement-position support, and which reward-location changes remain unexplained by behavioral confounds?
primary_outputs: Recomputable per-cell d-prime, regional fractions and animal-level before/after contrasts from measured neural arrays; the estimated effect may be null, negative or undefined. Reward-location d-prime is a separate unmatched statistic, not a known reward-coding truth.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: utils.load_spk opens {mname}_{datexp}_{blk}_neural_data.npy, concatenating the spks arrays into neurons × frames; these are calcium-derived activity estimates, not electrode spikes. Transform files map neurons into cortical areas.
recording_contract.labels: Beh_{experiment}.npy provides ft_WallID (stimulus), ft_trInd (trial), ft_move, ft_PosCum, ft_CorrSpc and ft_GraySpc, plus licking/reward fields. Imaging_Exp_info.npy identifies supervised/unsupervised/naive and before/after/test experiments.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Neural/behavior correspondence is explicitly frame-indexed: code truncates behavior vectors to nfr and optionally interpolates moving trials into 60 position bins over the corridor. Absolute sampling-time fields were not established; initial tasks use trial/frame/position coordinates, not exact millisecond latencies.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging_Exp_info records mname,datexp,blk; identical IDs occur in neural filenames and behavior keys. Preserve every date/block of one mname. Exact animal counts and cross-session cell correspondences are not independently loaded.
recording_contract.evidence: 297-file Figshare v2 manifest and pinned data_process_script.ipynb/utils.py directly establish neural/behavior filenames and keys. No NPY objects were loaded.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

For a future investigator, explicit permitted neural/behavioral observations and training reference data require separate packaging; current compound evaluator inputs include labels and are operator-only.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out animal/after-phase neural observations in fitting of the explanatory reference.
Undeclared cell registration, interpolated values treated as original independent frames, or source full-packet access used as a participant private-target route.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: session_manifest keys session_id,mname,datexp,blk,regime,phase must be unique and complete relative to supplied manifest; all declared mice require paired before/after phases. Actual native completeness remains unverified.
allowed_inputs.split: For descriptive contrasts, use all predeclared paired sessions and common movement-position support. Explanatory prediction holds every session of one mouse out and fits only before-phase sessions of other mice. Transductive behavioral matching is evaluator-side and is not candidate adaptation permission.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All supplied sessions, neurons and animals remain in denominators, with undefined support reported. Native figure-specific populations, safe interpolation identity and authentic full cohort have not been admitted.

primary.name: Common-support stimulus-selectivity change and supervised-minus-unsupervised animal contrast
primary.aggregation: Source arithmetic-SD d-prime for category2 versus0 on matched movement-position strata; fixed threshold regional fractions, session means within animal/phase, after−before per mouse and equal-mouse regime contrast.
primary.rationale: The endpoint is an estimated neural effect verified from observations, not agreement with a favored positive learning narrative. A future submission checker must verify numeric artifacts and stated uncertainty, without treating positive effects as answer correctness.

secondary: Source unmatched stimulus/reward-location d-prime fractions and moving-gray baseline activity, with matched coverage and undefined denominators.
Before-only leave-animal-out behavior-only versus stimulus-augmented ridge MSE, scaled MSE and complete held-out residuals.
Whole-trial stimulus null diagnostics within identical movement-position profiles, not calibrated p-values.

comparators.name: Behavior-only explanatory ridge
comparators.inputs: Position and source framewise movement; before-phase other-animal data only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only standardization and fixed ridge; equal animals/sessions/frames in training loss.

comparators.name: Stimulus-augmented explanatory ridge
comparators.procedure: Same held-animal and before-only fitting; retain all residuals, and treat amplitude calibration as unresolved.

comparators.name: Common-support and whole-trial null
comparators.inputs: Frozen joint movement/position strata and complete trial labels.
comparators.procedure: Implemented equal stratum weighting across every declared session/category; null permutes only exchangeable observed profiles, retaining fixed/nonexchangeable trials.

nuisance_controls: Separate raw stimulus, matched stimulus and unmatched reward-location endpoints; no reward-match claim from stimulus matching.
Source ft_move is VR position increment, not physical running speed; cue category does not guarantee reward delivery.
Freeze threshold/binning and neural amplitude calibration; never pair cells across sessions without registration.
evaluation.uncertainty: Animal bootstrap within regime for paired changes and independently across regimes for their difference; singleton/undefined animals prevent population intervals or complete estimates. Record coverage and retained biological denominators.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject inconsistent/missing sessions and arrays; zero dispersion d-prime and absent regions remain undefined without removing cells/animals. No common covariate support refuses the matched endpoint; no source narrative is substituted for missing truth.
